icp.summary: One- or two-sentence description of the source company's product and primary buyer.

targetCompany.geography: global; strongest in NL, UK, US

painPoints: A specific pain in customer language (verbatim quote where possible)
Another specific pain — describe what the customer LACKED before buying
buyingTriggers: A specific event (e.g. 'New CFO hired in last 9 months')
Another event-shaped trigger (not 'company is growing' — say 'Series B closed in 2026')

contactSearch.rationale: One sentence — why these titles map to the buying committee. Keyword is used only as fallback when title-only search returns zero (the CLI applies it AND-style with titles, which can over-constrain at small companies).

signals.question: An exact research question describing WHAT to find, not WHERE to look. Saber picks sources internally.
signals.interpretation: Positive when the list contains any of: tag_a, tag_b, tag_c.

signals.question: A question with an enumerable answer space — list each X the company uses, choosing from these exact tags: tag_one, tag_two, tag_three.
signals.interpretation: Positive when the list contains any of: tag_one, tag_two.

signals.question: A time-bounded question. In the last X months, has the company done Y? For each instance, return Field1, Field2, Field3, Field4. If none, respond with: No qualifying instances.
signals.interpretation: Positive when at least one instance is returned.
